```{r}
#| label: setup
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)
library(IssueTrackeR)
library(htmltools)
library(here)

# IssueTrackerR configs
options(IssueTrackeR.dataset.dir = here::here("data/gh"))
options(IssueTrackeR.owner = "ImperialCollegeLondon")
options(IssueTrackeR.repo = "ve_data_science")

# Set global options for all DT tables
options(
  DT.options = list(
    pageLength = 5,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    # 2. Pre-populate specific column filters
    searchCols = list(
      NULL,
      NULL,
      NULL,
      list(search = '["open"]'),
      NULL
    )
  )
)

# function to render the interactive table
render_issues <- function(issue) {
  issue |>
    select(-milestone) |>
    datatable(
      rownames = FALSE,
      colnames = c(
        "Issue" = "number",
        "Title" = "title",
        "Body (truncated)" = "body",
        "State" = "state",
        "Created at" = "created_at"
      ),
      filter = "top",
      escape = 2
    )
}

# function for a HTML progress bar
progress_bar <- function(x, total = 100, color = "#2c7bb6") {
  pct <- round(x / total * 100)
  lbl <- paste0(pct, "% complete; ", total - x, " open; ", x, " closed")

  tags$div(
    style = "margin: 1rem 0",
    tags$div(
      style = "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #555; margin-bottom: 4px;",
      tags$span("Progress"),
      tags$span(lbl)
    ),
    tags$div(
      style = "background: #e9ecef; border-radius: 999px; height: 10px; overflow: hidden;",
      tags$div(
        style = glue::glue(
          "width: {pct}%; height: 100%; background: {color};
           border-radius: 999px; transition: width 0.6s ease;"
        )
      )
    )
  )
}

# function that applies progress_bar() to a milestone object
progress_bar_milestone <- function(milestone, ...) {
  tmp <- milestones |> filter(title == milestone)
  n_closed <- tmp$nb_issues_closed
  n_total <- tmp$nb_issues_open + tmp$nb_issues_closed
  progress_bar(n_closed, n_total, ...)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: read-issues
# download GitHub issues
issues <- get_issues(source = "online", state = "all", verbose = FALSE)
milestones <- get_milestones(source = "online", state = "all", verbose = FALSE)

# write_to_dataset(issues)
# update_database()

# prepare the issue tracker table
issue_table <-
  issues |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(creator == "hrlai") |>
  # Convert NA milestones to a string for grouping
  mutate(milestone = replace_na(as.character(milestone), "No Milestone")) |>
  # Arrange by milestone, then by our custom state order
  mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("open", "closed"))) |>
  arrange(milestone, state, desc(created_at)) |>
  # cleaner dates
  mutate_at(vars(created_at, closed_at), ymd) |>
  # Create a column for the linked number
  mutate(
    number = sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', html_url, number),
    body = str_trunc(body, 100),
  ) |>
  select(number, title, body, state, milestone, created_at)
```

# Overview {#sec-overview}

## Lastest description

This week, I updated model parameterisation and validation scripts by merging soil sensitivity refactoring ([#419](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/pull/419 "Refactor hard-coded settings in soil sensitivity analysis scripts")), AST-based docstring extraction ([#412](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/pull/412 "Experimental ast-based docstring extraction and constant--function mapping")), and Copilot integration tools ([#426](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/pull/426 "Add Copilot skills and extra instructions")). I also submitted a progress report on LLM literature searches for model constants ([#431](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/pull/431 "Progress report on LLM literature search for constant values")) and pinned the documentation framework version ([#422](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/pull/422 "Pin mkdocs-material version to 9.7.0")). For calibration and future workflows, team discussions focused on learning HPC mechanics to shift scenario inputs from data to config files ([#165](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/issues/165 "Issue 165")) and adopting the `calibrar` package to test parallelized, frequentist optimization methods ([#404](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/issues/404 "Issue 404")). Finally, I am coordinating efforts to troubleshoot cue logic inconsistencies ([#423](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/issues/423 "Issue 423")) and define a high-quality "gold standard" subset dataset for validation ([#425](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/issues/425 "Issue 425")).
